description: Quickstart for viaSocket: build and manage your viaSocket plugins (apps) in the Developer Hub (auth, actions, triggers, versions, reusable components, debugging), set up a product's viaSocket keys, give a product its own MCP server, and build automations (flows) for the user: find apps, connect accounts, create flows, set triggers and write steps. Routes plug work through the plug skills index, product integration and the product's MCP server through the viaSocket skill, and Embarko deploy through Embarko's quickstart. Load this before any viaSocket task. Call this to load the full instructions for this skill before doing the task.
name: quickstart-viasocket-developer-hub
